name: Mirabai
shortBio: Sixteenth-century Rajasthani Hindu mystic and Bhakti philosopher whose vernacular bhajans defended spiritual egalitarianism, affective knowledge, and female moral autonomy against Rajput courtly patriarchy.
centralQuestion: Can radical devotional love (prema-bhakti) supersede hereditary caste, royal authority, and patriarchal enclosure as an ethical path?

keyWorks.title: Padavali (Bhajans of Mirabai)
keyWorks.description: Devotional lyric corpus challenging caste and marital confinement through vernacular nirguna-saguna synthesis.
